capabilities: reveal allowed dotfiles and dotfolders in the native File Explorer
hide .obsidian, .trash, .git, and SQLite sidecars by default
temporarily reveal SQLite WAL/SHM sidecars for diagnostics
manually rescan the vault for hidden paths
sync Obsidian's unsupported-file visibility setting on enable and disable
disambiguation: Not a custom file manager or sidebar; it only toggles which hidden paths appear in the native File Explorer.
extras: Desktop-only because it patches the desktop file-system adapter via internal APIs that may need maintenance after Obsidian updates; listed in the community directory but not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; no telemetry or network requests.
intentEvidence: reveals safe dotfiles and dotfolders in Obsidian's native File Explorer
problem: Obsidian's File Explorer hides all dot-prefixed files and folders, so users cannot see or manage useful files like .gitignore, .env, or AI-agent config folders.
summary: Reveals safe dotfiles and dotfolders like .env and .claude/ in Obsidian's native desktop File Explorer, with configurable denylists and rescan.
